content.zonePairingNote: The Zone List is an entry point only. Before production, resolve one Zone File and exactly one Sub-Zone, then lock it across all scenes with only micro-variation.
productionRules: Use 9:16 vertical, full-body or clear editorial portrait depending on the page slot.
For StoryGenProduct, resolve Zone List → Zone File → exactly one Sub-Zone before generation.
Use 1 prompt = 1 outfit for production stability.
Do not mix multiple Sub-Zones inside one six-scene production set.
For sleepwear, resort swim-adjacent or sexy styling, apply the Ultra Policy Safe framework with non-sexualized luxury editorial tone.
No auto-publishing, marketplace write, order mutation or payment behavior from this content seed.

cta.title: Build the Outfit channel as the visual door into Chorn Planet.
cta.description: Start with these 10 seed sets, then expand into detail pages, product stories, Style validation and TikTok-first commerce once the platform layout is stable.

outfitSets.title: Rice Valley Couple Lanna
outfitSets.visualSummary: A romantic Lanna couple look for rice valley, lotus pond and rural tourism storytelling.
outfitSets.story: A romantic Lanna couple story shaped for rice valley travel, lotus pond rituals and warm rural hospitality. The look balances traditional northern elegance with soft editorial restraint so the outfit can move from cultural portrait to TikTok commerce without losing its sense of place.

outfitSets.title: Coastal Resort Floral
outfitSets.visualSummary: A floral coastal resort set for beach walkway, overwater villas and premium summer lifestyle.
outfitSets.story: A bright resort wardrobe for coastal walkways, overwater villas and summer arrival moments. Floral color, light movement and relaxed silhouette make the set feel premium, easy to shop and ready for short-form travel storytelling.

outfitSets.title: Waterfall Citrus Travel
outfitSets.visualSummary: A bright short-sleeve travel look for waterfall decks, nature trails and light adventure tourism.
outfitSets.story: A citrus travel look built for waterfall decks, forest paths and light adventure scenes. The outfit keeps the product recognizable while giving nature content a fresh, energetic and approachable commerce angle.

outfitSets.title: Lotus Smart Food Café
outfitSets.visualSummary: A soft café outfit designed for food plates, lotus ponds, local dining and Smart Food lifestyle cards.
outfitSets.story: A soft cafe outfit made for lotus ponds, plated food, local dining and Smart Food lifestyle scenes. It turns menu storytelling into an elegant daily-life moment that can later connect to ordering and product discovery.

outfitSets.title: Lotus Lanna Ceremony
outfitSets.visualSummary: A refined purple Lanna outfit for lotus boardwalks, cultural travel and quiet luxury identity.
outfitSets.story: A refined Lanna ceremony look for lotus boardwalks and cultural hospitality. Purple tone, gold detail and calm posture position the outfit as quiet luxury rather than costume display.

outfitSets.title: Mountain Hydrangea Gentleman
outfitSets.visualSummary: A clean gentleman resort look with black-and-white tropical print for mountain terraces and hydrangea valleys.
outfitSets.story: A gentleman resort look for mountain terraces, hydrangea valleys and cool climate travel. Clean tropical print and restrained styling make the outfit useful for premium tourism, menswear content and destination retail.

outfitSets.title: Mountain Lanna Noble Woman
outfitSets.visualSummary: A green and gold Lanna outfit for flower valleys, mountain balconies and premium cultural portrait cards.
outfitSets.story: A noble Lanna woman look for flower valleys, mountain balconies and cultural identity portraits. Green, gold and structured elegance create a memorable visual signature for premium destination storytelling.

outfitSets.title: Flower Valley Gentleman Casual
outfitSets.visualSummary: A colorful floral shirt for accessible male travel content, garden walks and family-friendly tourism.
outfitSets.story: A casual gentleman floral look for garden walks, family tourism and accessible mountain valleys. The set keeps the mood colorful and friendly while still carrying enough polish for premium platform cards.

outfitSets.title: Coastal MTS Traveler
outfitSets.visualSummary: A light travel outfit with luggage and straw bag for MTS station, harbor arrival and coastal gateway stories.
outfitSets.story: A light traveler outfit for MTS stations, harbor arrivals and coastal gateway movement. Luggage, straw texture and clean travel styling make the set practical for route-based story commerce.

outfitSets.title: Soft Morning Luxury Safe
outfitSets.visualSummary: A safe, non-sexualized soft morning luxury look for hotel wellness, coffee ritual and calm hospitality storytelling.
outfitSets.story: A calm, safe morning luxury look for hotel wellness, coffee rituals and quiet hospitality. The styling is intentionally non-sexualized, polished and product-aware for premium lifestyle content.
